svg.aria-label: Two graphs over d from 0 to pi over 4. In each, the reserve of Lemma C.6 for w from 0 to d fills a light blue band whose lower edge, the reserve at w = 0, is drawn in blue: it falls from about 0.42 to about 0.12 in (a) and to about 0.08 in (b). Below it the dashed orange bound of the proof falls to about 0.057 in (a) and 0.050 in (b), still positive
